title: External product comparison for marked cone diagrams
statement:
Use [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison], [lem-coef-marked-point-cartesian-model] and [lem-coef-simplicial-projective-model-calculus]. For a small simplicial set $S$, a small simplicial category $I$ and a simplicial functor $u:\mathfrak C[S]\to I^{\mathrm{op}}$, define a marked $I$-diagram $L_u(X)$ for a marked map $X\to S$ as follows. Put $P_X=I^{\mathrm{op}}\amalg_{\mathfrak C[X]}\mathfrak C[X\star\Delta^0]$, with new cone vertex $v$, and $L_u(X)(i)=P_X(i,v)$. Precomposition gives the $I$-action, with each mapping simplicial set acting with all its edges marked, as for the tensor defining the simplicial model enrichment. The edge $e:x\to y$ gives a cone edge $\widetilde e:\widetilde x\to u(e)^*\widetilde y$; mark the edges $g^*\widetilde e$ for marked $e$ and every $g\in I^{\mathrm{op}}(i,u(x))_1$. Include all degenerate edges. 
Let $S,S'$ be small simplicial sets, $I,I'$ small simplicial categories, $u:\mathfrak C[S]\to I^{\mathrm{op}}$ and $u':\mathfrak C[S']\to (I')^{\mathrm{op}}$ simplicial functors, and $X\to S$, $X'\to S'$ marked objects. Let $u\boxtimes u'$ be the functor from $\mathfrak C[S\times S']$ to $(I\times I')^{\mathrm{op}}$ induced by the projections and $u,u'$. The two projections induce a natural map of marked $(I\times I')$-diagrams
$$L_{u\boxtimes u'}(X\times X')\longrightarrow L_u(X)\boxtimes L_{u'}(X'),\qquad (G\boxtimes H)(i,i')=G(i)\times H(i').$$
This map is an objectwise weak equivalence in the absolute marked Cartesian model. No local Kan hypothesis on either indexing category is imposed.
